lime-voltage.$description: Lime Voltage — Atmospheric section backgrounds, hero block — the single chromatic voice of the system, used at full-section scale rather than as UI accent

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, all borders, all icons, scroll-indicator fill, logo mark

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, nav element fills

fog-white.$description: Fog White — Secondary card surface, alternating section backgrounds

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Card borders, hairline dividers on white surfaces

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted helper text, secondary metadata, caption-level information

dm-sans.$description: Sole typeface — weight 700 for display and headings, 500 for navigation and subheadings, 400 for body and captions. The aggressive negative tracking at display sizes (-0.05em at 58px) is signature: DM Sans becomes a compressed, poster-like headline tool rather than a neutral body face. At body sizes tracking relaxes to -0.01em, giving copy a natural rhythm without feeling mechanical.
